title: Axiom Personal access token (xapt-): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one body byte as uppercase hex. Twin of "Axiom Personal access token (xapt-): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of axiom-personal-token-json-token: alphabet: one body byte as uppercase hex. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
